references.text: The eyes of the Lord are turned toward those who fear him, toward those who wait for his mercy
The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are open to their cry
The eyes of the Lord range over all the earth to strengthen those whose hearts are fully committed to him
The eyes of the Lord are everywhere, watching over the evil and the good
The seven eyes that range over all the earth represent the watchfulness of the Lord
The eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears are turned to their prayer
Description of the good land into which the Lord leads the people, with water springs and fertility
The Lord watches over his people like a well-tended tree
God will give rain at the right time and bless the land throughout the year
